veranderings.rede: Afrikaans idiom is 'op dieselfde plek'; 'in dieselfde plek' follows English 'in the same place'.

veranderings.voor: vol gras en baie min bome
veranderings.na: vol gras met baie min bome
veranderings.rede: 'vol ... en baie min bome' reads as 'full of very few trees'; 'met' attaches the few trees correctly without changing the meaning.
A river's sides are its 'walle' in natural Afrikaans; 'aan die kante' is vague and wooden.
